points.K14: 一次一瓶，双瓶车要固定
points.K15: 专业人员安装，使用者受训
points.K16: 用前先读标签和说明书
points.K18: 阀门伸手可及，通风良好

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排用链条固定的气瓶旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders chained to a wall rack and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲压缩气瓶的安全使用。
overlay: 压缩气瓶安全：实验室操作规程

shots.scene: 收货箱、货架、推车、阀门、警示灯五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a delivery box, a storage rack, a hand truck, a valve and a warning light. No people.
shots.narration: 验收、储存、搬运、使用、应急。

shots.scene: 阿杰双手抱着一只气瓶，侧着身往走廊里挪
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hugs a gas cylinder with both arms and shuffles sideways down a corridor.
shots.narration: 阿杰抱着一瓶气，想自己搬进实验室。

shots.scene: 老李推着推车赶来，摆手示意停下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hurries over pushing an empty cylinder hand truck and raises a hand to say stop.
shots.narration: 老李连忙拦住：气瓶可不能这么搬！

shots.section_title: 到货先核对，无标签拒收
shots.scene: 老李在门口对照空白订单核对气瓶标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank label on a delivered cylinder against a blank order form at the building entrance.
shots.narration: 气瓶还没进门，安全就开始了。
overlay: 到货先核对，无标签拒收

shots.section_title: 到货先核对，无标签拒收
shots.scene: 订单上是一种气体，瓶上标的是另一种，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank order form showing a green gas cloud icon next to a cylinder showing a different red flame icon, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 订的是氯气，瓶上就不该标着氢气。

shots.section_title: 到货先核对，无标签拒收
shots.scene: 没有标签的气瓶图标被打叉，旁边门图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon with no label, crossed out with a red X, next to a closed door icon. No people.
shots.narration: 没有标签的气瓶，绝不能进楼。

shots.scene: 老李绕着气瓶查看，摸一摸瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks around a cylinder looking for dents and touches the protective valve cap on top.
shots.narration: 还要看外观有无损伤，瓶帽在位完好。

shots.scene: 空白说明书放进文件夹，放上架子
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet being filed into a binder on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 每瓶的安全技术说明书，索取核对存档。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥、通风耐火
shots.scene: 整洁的气瓶间，有通风口和平整地面
shots.prompt_en: A tidy gas cylinder room with a wall ventilation grille, a level floor and fire-resistant walls. No people.
shots.narration: 储存处要阴凉、干燥、平整、通风、耐火。
overlay: 储存：阴凉干燥、通风耐火

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥、通风耐火
shots.scene: 三层规范文件图标叠在一起
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked blank regulation document icons of different sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 符合物料要求和地方、州、联邦法规，

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥、通风耐火
shots.scene: 行业标准文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank industry standard booklet icon with a cylinder symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 还要符合美国压缩气体协会的标准。

shots.scene: 太阳和暖气片图标连向气瓶，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A sun icon and a radiator icon pointing at a gas cylinder icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 远离热源，不放在阳光直射的地方，

shots.scene: 温度计指向约125华氏度
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with its reading pointing at a high marked level. No people.
shots.narration: 也不放在可能达到约125华氏度的地方。

shots.scene: 气瓶阀门上的泄压装置示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a cylinder valve with a small pressure relief device highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶要有泄压装置，

shots.scene: 火焰包围气瓶，泄压装置放出一点气
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder icon near flames with its relief device releasing a small puff. No people.
shots.narration: 防止火灾或高温超压爆炸。

shots.section_title: 直立固定，绳子扎带不算
shots.scene: 气瓶直立在墙边，用专用链条和卡箍固定
shots.prompt_en: Gas cylinders standing upright against a wall, each secured with a chain and a wall bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 所有气瓶都必须直立，妥善固定。
overlay: 直立固定，绳子扎带不算

shots.section_title: 直立固定，绳子扎带不算
shots.scene: 绳子、扎带、弹力绳、铁丝四个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Four icons crossed out with red X: a rope, a zip tie, a bungee cord and a wire. No people.
shots.narration: 弹力绳、扎带、绳子、铁丝都不合格。

shots.scene: 电梯口和天桥下的气瓶图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon placed near an elevator door and under a walkway with a falling box, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不放在电梯、通道等会有东西砸到的地方。

shots.scene: 走廊和出入口前的气瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon in a busy hallway and in front of an entrance door, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 也不放走廊、出入口，以防外人乱动。

shots.scene: 气瓶间门上贴着空白的名称牌和危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder room door with a blank name plate and hazard pictograms posted on it. No people.
shots.narration: 张贴每种气体的名称和危害，

shots.scene: 可燃气瓶与氧化性气瓶之间有隔墙
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a flame pictogram and a cylinder with a flame-over-circle pictogram separated by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 按危险类别分开，可燃气体远离氧化剂。

shots.scene: 老李关紧阀门、卸下减压阀、戴上瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes a cylinder valve, removes the regulator and screws on the valve cap.
shots.narration: 用空或不用：关阀、戴瓶帽、卸减压阀。

shots.scene: 空瓶挂空白吊牌，和满瓶分区放
shots.prompt_en: Empty cylinders with blank hanging tags stand in a separate zone from full cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 空瓶标明“空”，与满瓶分开存放。

shots.section_title: 搬运前拆减压阀、关阀门
shots.scene: 老李拆下减压阀和软管，检查阀门关紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer detaches the regulator and hose from a cylinder and checks that the valve is closed.
shots.narration: 搬运前，拆下减压阀、管路，关紧阀门。
overlay: 搬运前拆减压阀、关阀门

shots.scene: 拖着气瓶、滚着气瓶两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out: a person dragging a cylinder, and a cylinder rolling on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能拖着或滚着气瓶走。

shots.scene: 老李把气瓶固定在推车上推走
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer straps a capped cylinder onto a cylinder hand truck and wheels it away.
shots.narration: 只能用合适的推车或手推车。

shots.scene: 挂着空瓶牌的气瓶，旁边有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a blank empty tag and a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 就算标了空，也一律当满瓶搬。

shots.section_title: 一次一瓶，双瓶车要固定
shots.scene: 单瓶推车只推一只气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A single-cylinder hand truck carrying just one secured cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 一次只搬一瓶。
overlay: 一次一瓶，双瓶车要固定

shots.section_title: 一次一瓶，双瓶车要固定
shots.scene: 双瓶推车上两只气瓶都扣好链条
shots.prompt_en: A two-cylinder hand truck carrying two cylinders, both secured with chains. No people.
shots.narration: 要搬两瓶，用双瓶推车，先固定好。

shots.section_title: 专业人员安装，使用者受训
shots.scene: 老李给气瓶连接减压阀，阿杰在旁观看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer connects a regulator to a secured cylinder while the young male student watches.
shots.narration: 由供应商或受过培训的人来安装。
overlay: 专业人员安装，使用者受训

shots.section_title: 专业人员安装，使用者受训
shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰讲解气瓶标签和泄压阀
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank cylinder label and the relief valve to the young male student.
shots.narration: 使用者要培训：会认标签、会用泄压阀。

shots.section_title: 用前先读标签和说明书
shots.scene: 阿杰读气瓶标签，手里拿着空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank cylinder label while holding a blank safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 用之前，读完标签和说明书。
overlay: 用前先读标签和说明书

shots.scene: 小研用刷子在接头处涂肥皂水，出现小泡泡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles brushes soapy water on a regulator fitting, and small bubbles appear.
shots.narration: 所有接头，用肥皂水检漏。

shots.scene: 打火机靠近接头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lighter flame near a cylinder fitting, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用说，绝不能用明火检漏！

shots.section_title: 阀门伸手可及，通风良好
shots.scene: 气瓶阀门前空旷无遮挡，小研伸手可及
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student easily reaches a cylinder valve with nothing blocking the way.
shots.narration: 气瓶阀门要随时够得着。
overlay: 阀门伸手可及，通风良好

shots.section_title: 阀门伸手可及，通风良好
shots.scene: 顶部排风口在工作
shots.prompt_en: A ceiling exhaust vent working above a secured cylinder, with airflow lines. No people.
shots.narration: 只在通风良好的地方使用。

shots.scene: 老李逐段检查软管，把一段裂开的换掉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a gas hose section by section and replaces a cracked piece.
shots.narration: 定期检查管路，坏了立即拆换。

shots.scene: 压力表指针停在低位但未到零
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder pressure gauge needle resting at a low mark but not at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 不要用到25磅以下，防止空气杂质倒灌。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套、护目镜，穿防护服操作气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears gloves, safety goggles and a lab coat while opening a cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 压缩气体协会建议：戴手套、护目镜、防护服。

shots.section_title: 应急准备：灭火器和两条路
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白应急程序，大家围看
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank emergency procedure sheet; the female graduate student and the young male student read it.
shots.narration: 提前学习、理解所有应急程序。
overlay: 应急准备：灭火器和两条路

shots.section_title: 应急准备：灭火器和两条路
shots.scene: 墙上的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher hanging on a wall with clear space around it. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器随时可用、拿得到。

shots.section_title: 应急准备：灭火器和两条路
shots.scene: 平面图上两条绿色箭头通向两个出口
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with two green arrows leading to two different exits; one path is blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 至少记住两条路，一条堵了走另一条。

shots.section_title: 发现泄漏：告知、提醒、撤离
shots.scene: 洗眼器和喷淋标志，老李放水测试
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests an eyewash station and safety shower under their signs.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、喷淋就在附近，定期测试。
overlay: 发现泄漏：告知、提醒、撤离

shots.section_title: 发现泄漏：告知、提醒、撤离
shots.scene: 小研招呼大家离开，指向出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waves others toward the exit and points the way out.
shots.narration: 发现泄漏：立即告诉主管，提醒别人，撤离。

shots.section_title: 低温冻伤：温水复温、就医
shots.scene: 手在温水下冲洗的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand under lukewarm running water. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤碰到冷冻液化气，立即用温水复温，
overlay: 低温冻伤：温水复温、就医

shots.section_title: 低温冻伤：温水复温、就医
shots.scene: 医院红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: A hospital building icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 并去就医。

shots.scene: 欣欣深呼吸，手里拿着电话
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot takes a calm deep breath while holding a telephone.
shots.narration: 万一控制不住，保持冷静，拨打911。

shots.scene: 规程本和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure booklet icon with a shield and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 遵守安全规程，是预防事故的最好办法。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现标签、链条、推车图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a cylinder label, a chain and a cylinder hand truck.
shots.narration: 核对标签，直立固定，推车搬运。

shots.scene: 肥皂泡、通风、压力表三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: soap bubbles, a ventilation fan and a pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 肥皂水检漏，通风使用，留余压。

shots.scene: 出口、洗眼器、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exit sign, an eyewash station and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏就告知撤离，冻伤用温水。

shots.scene: 欣欣在固定好的气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside neatly chained gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 气瓶用得稳，实验才安心，下次见！
